<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>VIRO VAULT — Escape • Solve • Survive</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#050b12;--panel:#0b1721;--panel2:#101f2a;--cyan:#63e6f2;--teal:#1cb9c5;--red:#ff465c;--amber:#ffbd59;--muted:#91a5b2;--line:#1d3947}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%,#142a37 0,#07111a 42%,#03070c 100%);color:#e8f4f7;font:15px/1.45 system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,sans-serif;min-height:100vh}
body:before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.13;background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0 3px,#8cecf2 4px,transparent 5px);mix-blend-mode:screen}
.wrap{max-width:1100px;margin:auto;padding:22px}.top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;flex-wrap:wrap;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:15px}
.brand{letter-spacing:.22em;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(20px,4vw,30px);text-shadow:0 0 18px #36cbd8}.brand small{display:block;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.35em;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.timer{font:800 clamp(28px,5vw,42px)/1 ui-monospace,monospace;color:var(--cyan);text-shadow:0 0 16px #2bd3e4;background:#06131b;border:1px solid #246071;border-radius:9px;padding:12px 18px;min-width:150px;text-align:center}.timer.warn{color:var(--amber);border-color:#805d2a}.timer.danger{color:#ff5668;border-color:#a12b3c;animation:pulse 1s infinite}@keyframes pulse{50%{opacity:.55}}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr .8fr;gap:16px;margin-top:18px}.panel{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#10212cdd,#07131ddd);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;padding:18px;box-shadow:0 12px 35px #0008}.panel h2,.panel h3{margin:0 0 12px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}.eyebrow{color:var(--cyan);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.22em;font-weight:800}.muted{color:var(--muted)}.roomhead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}.progress{display:flex;gap:7px;margin:15px 0}.pip{height:5px;flex:1;border-radius:5px;background:#233944}.pip.done{background:var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 10px #37cbd7}
.symbols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px;margin:15px 0}.tile{min-height:72px;border:1px solid #315361;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#152b37,#0a1821);color:#ffffff;font-size:30px;cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:.15s;box-shadow:inset 0 0 12px #0008}.tile:hover{border-color:var(--cyan);transform:translateY(-2px)}.tile.selected{background:#c4f5f5;border:2px solid var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 16px #2bd3e477}
.slots{display:flex;gap:10px;min-height:75px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}.slot{width:70px;height:70px;border:1px dashed #477080;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:29px;background:#06121a;color:var(--cyan)}.slot.filled{border-style:solid;background:#12313b;cursor:grab}.actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:15px}
button,input{font:inherit}button{border:1px solid #315b6b;background:#102936;color:#e9fbff;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:.04em}button:hover{border-color:var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 12px #35cbd455}button.primary{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#087e8c,#145a70);border-color:#39cbd7}button.danger{border-color:#803543;color:#ff9aa5}button:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:not-allowed;box-shadow:none}
.side{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}.stat{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;border-bottom:1px solid #1c3440;padding:8px 0}.stat b{color:var(--cyan)}.log{max-height:180px;overflow:auto;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}.log div{padding:5px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #172b35}
.screen{display:none}.screen.active{display:block}.center{text-align:center}.hero{padding:55px 15px}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(34px,7vw,64px);letter-spacing:.18em;margin:8px 0;text-shadow:0 0 22px #1bb5c5}.hero p{max-width:620px;margin:12px auto 25px;color:#a8bdc8}.field{background:#06121a;border:1px solid #315361;border-radius:8px;color:white;padding:12px;width:min(300px,100%);margin:10px}.notice{padding:12px;border-radius:8px;background:#102a34;border:1px solid #285866;margin:12px 0}.notice.bad{border-color:#853444;background:#31131c;color:#ffb2ba}.notice.good{border-color:#267d75;background:#0e302d;color:#9ef5dc}
.list{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:14px}.list th,.list td{text-align:left;padding:9px;border-bottom:1px solid #203844}.list th{color:var(--cyan);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em}
.dragpool{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:14px 0}.dragsym{color:#ffffff;font-size:29px;width:60px;height:60px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#132c38;border:1px solid #3b6572;border-radius:9px;cursor:grab}.dragsym.used{opacity:.25;pointer-events:none}.finalslots{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;margin:20px 0}.finalslot{color:#ffffff;width:58px;height:62px;border:1px dashed #54808e;border-radius:8px;background:#06131a;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:27px}.finalslot.over{border-color:var(--cyan);background:#123b45}.finalslot span{cursor:grab}.hidden{display:none!important}
@media(max-width:760px){.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.symbols{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.tile{min-height:65px}.wrap{padding:13px}.panel{padding:14px}}
 
.crossword-panel{margin:16px 0;padding:15px;border:1px solid #294956;border-radius:11px;background:#07141c}
.crossword-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(210px,.8fr);gap:18px;align-items:start}
.crossword-scroll{overflow:auto;padding:5px}
.crossword-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(15,30px);grid-template-rows:repeat(10,30px);gap:2px;width:max-content}
.cw-cell{width:30px;height:30px;position:relative;background:#dce8e9;border:1px solid #8ca9ad}
.cw-cell input{width:100%;height:100%;border:0;background:transparent;color:#07131a;text-align:center;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:850;font-size:17px;padding:0;outline:none}
.cw-cell input:focus{background:#b8f5f5;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #13b9c8}
.cw-cell.black{background:#071019;border-color:#071019}
.cw-num{position:absolute;top:0;left:2px;font-size:8px;color:#172b32;line-height:1;pointer-events:none}
.clues{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:10px}.clues h4{margin:0 0 5px;color:var(--cyan);letter-spacing:.15em;font-size:12px}
.clues ol{margin:0;padding-left:25px}.clues li{padding:3px 0;color:#c2d3d9;font-size:13px}
@media(max-width:760px){.crossword-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.crossword-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(15,27px);grid-template-rows:repeat(10,27px)}.cw-cell{width:27px;height:27px}}

/* VIRO VAULT // aged escape-box visual theme */
:root{--bg:#17130e;--panel:#211b14;--panel2:#30261b;--cyan:#f0c98b;--teal:#b9854c;--red:#b43c2c;--amber:#e0ad62;--muted:#c1a987;--line:#755a3a}
body{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%,#57432b 0,#211a12 42%,#100d09 100%);color:#f4e4c7}

.wrap{max-width:1160px}.top{border-bottom:2px solid #896b43}

.timer.warn{color:#ffce79;border-color:#c28a3c}.timer.danger{color:#ff7661;border-color:#a43c2d}
.panel{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#2b241bdd,#17120ddd);border:1px solid #80613b;border-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 12px 35px #000a,inset 0 0 28px #8e68301a;position:relative}

.panel h2,.panel h3{color:#f0d0a0;text-shadow:0 1px #000}.eyebrow{color:#e5bd7e}.muted{color:#c0aa89}
button{border:1px solid #a17c4e;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3c2c1b,#1b1510);color:#f4dfbd;border-radius:3px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 10px #0008}

button.danger{border-color:#a94a37;color:#ffb09a}

.tile:hover{border-color:#f2d19c}.tile.selected{background:#6b4a29;border:2px solid #f0c98b;box-shadow:0 0 16px #d9a85c77}

.notice{background:#302319;border:1px solid #987044;color:#f4dfbd;border-radius:3px}
.notice.bad{border-color:#a34835;background:#351a13;color:#ffc0a5}.notice.good{border-color:#987344;background:#352819;color:#f5d9a7}

/* VIRO VAULT escape-box artwork treatment: open kraft-cardboard package */
:root{--paper:#d7c2a0;--paper-hi:#ead8b8;--ink:#17130e;--kraft:#705334;--gold:#e4c18a;--edge:#392819}
html{background:#eee9df}
body{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 12%,#f8f5ee 0,#e9e2d5 70%,#d4c9b8 100%);color:#f1dfbd;padding:18px 0 35px}
body:before{opacity:.22;background-image:radial-gradient(#8c7557 0.6px,transparent .8px),radial-gradient(#5b4730 .5px,transparent .8px);background-size:7px 7px,13px 13px;mix-blend-mode:multiply}
.wrap{position:relative;isolation:isolate;max-width:1160px;padding:22px 28px 30px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#17130e 0%,#2a2117 45%,#100d09 100%);border:7px solid #60472c;outline:1px solid #b28b57;box-shadow:0 20px 48px #30231477,inset 0 0 0 2px #b08a5744,inset 0 0 65px #000;}
.wrap:before{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:-2;left:-30px;right:-30px;top:135px;bottom:115px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#b9a17c,#e0ceb0 13%,#c7b18e 50%,#e1cfb0 87%,#aa9069);border:2px dashed #4b3926;box-shadow:0 8px 22px #0004;}
.wrap:after{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:-2;left:0;right:0;top:-17px;height:145px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#2a2117,#15110c);border:2px solid #8c6b40;border-bottom:3px dashed #b69a70;box-shadow:0 8px 18px #0006;}
.top{padding:13px 16px 16px;border:1px solid #8e6c42;border-bottom:2px dashed #c4a477;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#17130e,#292015);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 4px #0c0906, inset 0 0 0 5px #7c5d37}
.brand{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(25px,4vw,36px);letter-spacing:.16em;color:#f0d2a0;text-shadow:2px 3px #080604,0 0 12px #b88a4f}
.brand small{font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.22em;color:#c4a477}
.timer{border:2px solid #b18b58;border-radius:2px;background:#0b0906;color:#f3d4a1;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #342414,0 0 0 1px #080604;font-family:Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:.06em}
.box-meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:0;margin:0 auto 18px;max-width:760px;padding:13px 10px 12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#17130e,#282016);border:1px solid #8e6c42;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 4px #0c0906,inset 0 0 0 5px #7c5d37;color:#e9d0a4;text-align:center}
.box-meta>div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:3px;padding:2px 8px;border-right:1px solid #8c6b43}.box-meta>div:last-child{border:0}.box-meta b{font:26px Georgia,serif;color:#e9c58d}.box-meta span{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.13em;color:#d1b17e;font-weight:800}.box-meta strong{font:700 10px/1.35 Georgia,serif;color:#f4dfb8}
.panel{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#d8c5a4 0%,#c4ad87 48%,#e0cfb1 100%);color:#21180f;border:2px solid #765633;border-radius:2px;box-shadow:0 9px 24px #0007,inset 0 0 0 4px #e4d3b5,inset 0 0 0 5px #80613d;}
.panel:after{inset:8px;border:1px dashed #8d704b55}
.panel h2,.panel h3{color:#21170e;text-shadow:1px 1px #ead9b8;font-family:Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:.08em}
.eyebrow{color:#704a25;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.18em}.muted{color:#59452e}
.hero h1{color:#24180e;text-shadow:2px 2px #e7d3ae,3px 4px #8a6840;font-family:Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:.13em}
.hero p{color:#493723}
.field{background:#f0e3ca;color:#24180e;border:1px solid #765633;box-shadow:inset 0 2px 5px #6d4f2b33}
button{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#282016,#100d09);color:#f1d6a6;border:1px solid #a17b4b;border-radius:2px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #080604,0 2px 4px #0005;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:12px}
button.primary{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#8b6338,#4b321c);color:#fff0d3;border-color:#e0bb82}
button.danger{color:#ffd0bd;border-color:#9f4d39}
button:hover{border-color:#f0d19b;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #d7b27a44,inset 0 0 0 2px #080604}
.grid{gap:17px}.game .panel{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#d9c7a8,#bca17a)}
#game .grid>main.panel{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#211a12,#110e09);color:#f1dfbd;border-color:#a17a49;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 5px #080604,inset 0 0 0 6px #8a683e,0 10px 25px #0008}
#game .grid>main.panel h2,#game .grid>main.panel h3{color:#f0d2a0;text-shadow:1px 2px #090704}
#game .grid>main.panel .eyebrow{color:#d9b77f}#game .grid>main.panel .muted{color:#c8b18d}
#game .side .panel{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#d9c7a8,#bca17a);color:#281d12}
#game .side .panel h3{color:#2a1d11}
#game .side .stat{border-color:#9b815d}#game .side .stat b{color:#71451e}
#game .side .log{color:#59452e}#game .side .log div{border-color:#ad9673}
.progress .pip{background:#59432b}.progress .pip.done{background:#a46d34;box-shadow:0 0 8px #c3924f}
.tile,.dragsym{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#211910,#090806);border:1px solid #b08a56;color:#fff8e9;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #080604,0 2px 5px #0007}
.tile.selected{background:#71502d;border:2px solid #f1d4a0;box-shadow:0 0 12px #d7ad6b88}
.slot,.finalslot{background:#110d08;border:1px dashed #d0a76c;color:#fff0d4}.slot.filled{background:#4b321c;border-color:#e1bc83}
.notice{background:#3b2b1a;color:#f5dfba;border-color:#a68150}.notice.good{background:#2e2818;color:#f3d6a3;border-color:#c5a06a}.notice.bad{background:#391c14;color:#ffd0b7;border-color:#a34c34}
.crossword-panel{background:#d6c19c;border:2px solid #755533;color:#24190e;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #ead9b9}.crossword-panel .eyebrow,.clues h4{color:#69451f}.clues li{color:#3e2d1b}.cw-cell{background:#f1e6d1;border-color:#876b49}.cw-cell input{color:#1b130c}.cw-cell.black{background:#1c1710;border-color:#1c1710}
.list th{color:#70451e}.list th,.list td{border-color:#a58b65;color:#2b2015}
#menu.panel{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#d9c7a8,#bca17a);border:3px solid #6e4d2b;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 6px #e8d8b9,inset 0 0 0 8px #765633,0 12px 30px #0008}
#menu .eyebrow{display:inline-block;background:#21180f;color:#f0d0a0;padding:7px 13px;border:1px solid #a98250}
#menu h1{display:inline-block;background:#17120d;color:#f1d3a0;padding:18px 24px;border:3px double #b28a55;box-shadow:7px 7px 0 #8d6a40;max-width:100%}
#menu p{color:#3c2a18}
#final.panel,#victory.panel,#failed.panel,#board.panel,#history.panel,#help.panel{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#d9c7a8,#bca17a);color:#24190e}
#final .eyebrow,#victory .eyebrow,#failed .eyebrow{color:#704a25}
@media(max-width:760px){body{padding:8px 0}.wrap{margin:8px;padding:12px 10px 18px;border-width:4px}.wrap:before{left:-8px;right:-8px;top:115px;bottom:90px}.wrap:after{top:-8px;height:110px}.box-meta{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));padding:8px 3px}.box-meta>div{padding:2px 3px}.box-meta b{font-size:18px}.box-meta span{font-size:7px}.box-meta strong{font-size:8px}.top{padding:10px 8px}.brand{font-size:22px}.brand small{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.1em}.timer{min-width:105px;font-size:27px;padding:9px 10px}}

/* Post-room symbol keyboard and dramatic recovered-file details */
body:after{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;opacity:.13;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 7% 16%,#741b16 0 2%,transparent 11%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 93% 82%,#6e1714 0 1.5%,transparent 9%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 78% 12%,#8a2118 0 1%,transparent 7%);mix-blend-mode:multiply}
.wrap{z-index:1}
.symbol-keyboard{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px;margin:15px 0;padding:12px;background:#bca17a;border:2px solid #765633;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #e6d5b5}
.symbol-key{min-width:0;min-height:62px;padding:5px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#f1e5ce,#d7c09a);border:1px solid #765633;display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #f7eddb}
.symbol-key img{width:42px;height:42px;object-fit:contain;mix-blend-mode:multiply;pointer-events:none}
.symbol-key:hover{background:#c8a77a;border-color:#8b3027;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.symbol-entry{min-height:82px;gap:8px}
.symbol-entry-item{width:62px;height:62px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#f3e6ce;border:1px solid #8b6a45}
.symbol-entry-item img{width:48px;height:48px;object-fit:contain;mix-blend-mode:multiply}
@media(max-width:650px){.symbol-keyboard{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px;padding:7px}.symbol-key{min-height:55px}.symbol-key img{width:36px;height:36px}}


.r1-crossword-real{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(18,30px);grid-template-rows:repeat(14,30px);gap:2px;width:max-content;max-width:100%;margin:16px auto;padding:10px;background:#b69c72;border:2px solid #59432a;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 4px #d9c49e,0 5px 15px #4b321f55}
.cw-square{position:relative;width:30px;height:30px;background:#f3e8d2;border:1px solid #786044}.cw-square.block{background:#261c13;border-color:#261c13}
.cw-square input{width:100%;height:100%;padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;color:#24180e;text-align:center;text-transform:uppercase;font:bold 16px Georgia,serif;outline:none}
.cw-square input:focus{background:#ead2a4;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #9b3026}.cw-square .cw-number{position:absolute;top:0;left:2px;font:9px/1 Arial,sans-serif;color:#684a2a;pointer-events:none}
.cw-clues{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;margin:12px 0}.cw-clues h4{font:bold 14px Georgia,serif;color:#7b2c24;border-bottom:1px solid #a58b65;padding-bottom:5px}
.cw-clues ol{margin:0;padding-left:26px}.cw-clues li{padding:3px 0;color:#342719;font:14px/1.35 Georgia,serif}
.room4-answer{width:100%;max-width:100%;margin:6px 0 12px}
.measles-infographic{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin:20px auto;max-width:760px;text-align:left}
.measles-infographic .info-card{background:#f1e5ce;border:1px solid #987b53;padding:13px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #e2cfaa}
.measles-infographic strong{display:block;color:#7d2d24;font:bold 16px Georgia,serif;margin-bottom:5px}
@media(max-width:700px){.r1-crossword-real{grid-template-columns:repeat(18,22px);grid-template-rows:repeat(14,22px);gap:1px;padding:6px}.cw-square{width:22px;height:22px}.cw-square input{font-size:13px}.cw-square .cw-number{font-size:7px}.cw-clues,.measles-infographic{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

@keyframes shadowFlicker{0%,17%,19%,21%,58%,60%,100%{filter:brightness(1)}18%,59%{filter:brightness(.76)}}
#game .panel{animation:shadowFlicker 13s infinite}
/* High-contrast white symbol keys for clear visibility */
.symbol-key{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fffefa,#e9e4d9)!important;border:2px solid #fff!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #5a351c,0 3px 10px #000b,inset 0 0 0 2px #fff!important}
.symbol-key img{filter:grayscale(1) brightness(.28) contrast(1.45)!important;mix-blend-mode:multiply!important}
.symbol-key:hover{background:#fff!important;border-color:#d8b77e!important;box-shadow:0 0 18px #f3d9a6aa!important}
.symbol-entry-item{background:#fffefa!important;border:2px solid #fff!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #76502e!important}
.symbol-entry-item img{filter:grayscale(1) brightness(.25) contrast(1.5)!important}

/* ORIGINAL CODE STYLE: pure black boxes with clearly visible white symbols */
.symbol-keyboard{background:#000!important;border:2px solid #777!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #111!important}
.symbol-key{background:#000!important;border:1px solid #aaa!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #222!important}
.symbol-key img,.symbol-entry-item img{filter:invert(1) contrast(1.15)!important;mix-blend-mode:normal!important}
.symbol-key:hover{background:#202020!important;border-color:#fff!important;box-shadow:0 0 12px #ffffff55!important}
.symbol-entry-item{background:#000!important;border:1px solid #aaa!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #222!important}
.symbol-entry{background:#000!important;border-color:#aaa!important}

.answer-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr));gap:12px;margin:18px 0}
.answer-slot{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;padding:10px;background:#21150f;border:1px solid #8a6846;border-radius:8px}
.answer-slot label{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#e8d7bd;font-weight:800}
.answer-slot .field{width:100%;max-width:100%;box-sizing:border-box}

/* Room 3 true/false statements: improve readability */
#tfFields .answer-slot label{color:#ffffff!important;}

</style></head>
<body><div class="wrap">
<header class="top"><div class="brand">VIRO VAULT<small>THE UNKNOWN OUTBREAK • ABANDONED MEDICAL LABORATORY</small></div><div id="timer" class="timer">60:00</div></header>
<section id="menu" class="screen active panel hero center">
 <div class="eyebrow">ABANDONED FACILITY // MEDICAL ALERT</div><h1>CAN YOU ESCAPE?</h1>
 <p>A highly contagious pathogen has breached containment. You are the medical team entering an abandoned laboratory. Restore the records, analyse the findings, identify the virus and determine how to stop the outbreak before the facility is sealed.</p>
 <div id="singleSetup" class="muted" style="font-size:13px;margin:18px auto 12px;max-width:620px">ENTER YOUR NAME TO BEGIN THE MISSION.<input id="singleName" class="field" maxlength="120" placeholder="ENTER YOUR NAME" style="margin-top:12px"></div>
 <div class="actions" style="justify-content:center"><button class="primary" id="start">START NEW MISSION</button><button id="continueMission" style="display:none">CONTINUE SAVED MISSION</button></div><div id="saveNotice" class="muted" style="font-size:12px"></div>
 <div class="actions" style="justify-content:center"><button id="showBoard">LEADERBOARD</button><button id="showHistory">MISSION HISTORY</button><button id="how">HOW TO PLAY</button></div>
 <p class="muted" style="font-size:12px">EXAMINE • ANALYSE • DIAGNOSE • REPORT</p>
</section>

<section id="game" class="screen">
 <div class="grid"><main class="panel">
  <div class="roomhead"><div><div class="eyebrow" id="roomTag">LAB STATION 01 / 04</div><h2 id="roomTitle">THE INFECTION ROOM</h2></div><div class="eyebrow" id="roomNeed">EVIDENCE REQUIRED</div></div>
  <div class="progress" id="progress"><span class="pip"></span><span class="pip"></span><span class="pip"></span><span class="pip"></span></div>
  <p class="muted" id="roomText">Investigate the patient records and transmission reports.</p>
  <div id="puzzleArea"></div>
  <div id="feedback" aria-live="polite"></div>
 </main><aside class="side">
  <div class="panel"><h3>Mission controls</h3><div class="actions"><button type="button" class="danger" id="stop">STOP</button><button type="button" id="restart">RESTART</button><button type="button" id="sound">SOUND: ON</button></div><div class="stat"><span>Operator</span><b id="operator">—</b></div><div class="stat"><span>Chamber</span><b id="roomCount">1 / 4</b></div><div class="stat"><span>Errors</span><b id="errors">0</b></div><div class="stat"><span>Completed</span><b id="completed">0 / 4</b></div></div>
  <div class="panel"><h3>Facility log</h3><div class="log" id="log">No activity recorded.</div></div>
 </aside></div>
</section>

<section id="final" class="screen panel center"><div class="eyebrow">FINAL LABORATORY ACCESS</div><h2>FINAL IDENTIFICATION</h2><p class="muted">CENTRAL CONTROL ACCESS</p><div class="notice">FINAL VERIFICATION</div><div id="finalSymbolArea"></div></section>

<section id="victory" class="screen panel center hero">
 <div class="eyebrow">MEDICAL INVESTIGATION: COMPLETE</div><h1>DIAGNOSIS CONFIRMED</h1><h2 style="font-size:clamp(30px,7vw,56px);color:var(--cyan);letter-spacing:.25em" id="reveal">—</h2>
 <p>The medical investigation is complete. The pathogen has been identified as measles, and the appropriate prevention and outbreak-control measures have been reviewed.</p><div class="notice good" id="resultStats"></div><div class="actions" style="justify-content:center"><button id="victoryBoard">VIEW LEADERBOARD</button><button id="again">MAIN MENU</button></div>
</section>

<section id="failed" class="screen panel center hero"><div class="eyebrow">LABORATORY LOCKDOWN</div><h1 style="color:var(--red)">MISSION TERMINATED</h1><p id="failReason">The emergency clock has expired.</p><div class="actions" style="justify-content:center"><button id="retry">RETRY MISSION</button><button id="failMenu">MAIN MENU</button></div></section>

<section id="board" class="screen panel"><div class="roomhead"><h2>LEADERBOARD</h2><button class="back">BACK</button></div><p class="muted">Fastest successful mission times. Records are stored on this device.</p><div id="boardTable"></div></section>
<section id="history" class="screen panel"><div class="roomhead"><h2>MISSION HISTORY</h2><button class="back">BACK</button></div><div id="historyTable"></div></section>
<section id="help" class="screen panel"><div class="roomhead"><h2>HOW TO PLAY</h2><button class="back">BACK</button></div>
<p><strong>Welcome, Player.</strong> You are part of a medical response team sent into an abandoned laboratory after a mysterious outbreak. The facility has been left without power, and its research records are scattered throughout the rooms. Examine the findings, complete each laboratory task and identify the pathogen before the emergency system shuts down.</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>Enter your name and start the mission.</strong> You will complete the investigation with your team.</li>
<li><strong>Investigate the four lab records in order.</strong> Read every report carefully and complete the activities in each room. Enter your answers in the spaces provided.</li>
<li><strong>Move through the laboratory.</strong> Complete each room’s activity and pass its access check to unlock the next investigation room.</li>
<li><strong>Watch the emergency clock.</strong> An incorrect answer adds an error and deducts one minute. The timer continues as you move between laboratory stations.</li>
<li><strong>Use the laboratory controls.</strong> Stop saves your unfinished progress and returns to the main page. Continue Saved Mission resumes it later. Restart begins a new attempt. You can switch the background sound on or off.</li>
<li><strong>Complete the investigation.</strong> Finish all four lab records to reveal the pathogen and complete the mission.</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Dr X's reminder:</strong> Examine each laboratory finding carefully and base your diagnosis on the evidence. Every result matters. Good luck, Player.</p></section>
</div>


<script>
(()=>{
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
let state={},tick=null,audioOn=true,ctx=null,ambienceTimer=null,ambienceNodes=[],voiceWarnings=new Set(),voiceQueueBusy=false;

const getStore=k=>{try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k)||"[]")}catch{return[]}};
const putStore=(k,v)=>localStorage.setItem(k,JSON.stringify(v));
const SAVE_KEY="viroVaultSavedMission";
function captureInputs(){return [...document.querySelectorAll("#puzzleArea input, #puzzleArea select, #finalSymbolArea input")].map((el,i)=>({i,value:el.value,checked:!!el.checked}));}
function restoreInputs(items){if(!Array.isArray(items))return;const els=[...document.querySelectorAll("#puzzleArea input, #puzzleArea select, #finalSymbolArea input")];items.forEach(x=>{if(els[x.i]){els[x.i].value=x.value??"";if("checked" in els[x.i])els[x.i].checked=!!x.checked;}});}
function saveGame(){if(!state.started||state.ended)return;try{localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY,JSON.stringify({state:{...state,started:Date.now()-(3600-(state.remaining||3600))*1000},inputs:captureInputs(),log:$('log')?.innerHTML||"",mode:state.screenMode||"room"}));updateContinueButton();}catch(e){console.warn("Unable to save mission",e)}}
function clearSavedGame(){localStorage.removeItem(SAVE_KEY);updateContinueButton();}
function updateContinueButton(){const saved=!!localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY);const b=$("continueMission");if(b)b.style.display=saved?"inline-flex":"none";const n=$("saveNotice");if(n)n.textContent=saved?"A saved mission is available on this device.":"";}
const show=id=>{document.querySelectorAll(".screen").forEach(x=>x.classList.remove("active"));$(id).classList.add("active")};
const shuffle=a=>{a=[...a];for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){let j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]}return a};
const fmt=s=>{s=Math.max(0,s);return String(Math.floor(s/60)).padStart(2,"0")+":"+String(s%60).padStart(2,"0")};
function sound(freq=440,dur=.12,type="sine"){if(!audioOn)return;try{ctx=ctx||new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();if(ctx.state==='suspended')ctx.resume();let o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.value=freq;g.gain.setValueAtTime(.035,ctx.currentTime);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,ctx.currentTime+dur);o.connect(g);g.connect(ctx.destination);o.start();o.stop(ctx.currentTime+dur)}catch{}}
function bombThud(){if(!audioOn)return;try{ctx=ctx||new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();if(ctx.state==='suspended')ctx.resume();const now=ctx.currentTime;
 // Deep explosive pressure wave
 const osc=ctx.createOscillator(),gain=ctx.createGain(),filter=ctx.createBiquadFilter();osc.type='sine';osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(118,now);osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(28,now+1.25);filter.type='lowpass';filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(180,now);filter.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(48,now+1.1);gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,now);gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(.48,now+.018);gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,now+1.45);osc.connect(filter);filter.connect(gain);gain.connect(ctx.destination);osc.start(now);osc.stop(now+1.5);
 // Sharp blast and falling debris
 const n=Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate*.9),buf=ctx.createBuffer(1,n,ctx.sampleRate),d=buf.getChannelData(0);for(let i=0;i<n;i++)d[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*Math.pow(1-i/n,1.7);const src=ctx.createBufferSource(),ng=ctx.createGain(),nf=ctx.createBiquadFilter();src.buffer=buf;nf.type='lowpass';nf.frequency.setValueAtTime(1400,now);nf.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(120,now+.85);ng.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,now);ng.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(.34,now+.012);ng.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,now+.92);src.connect(nf);nf.connect(ng);ng.connect(ctx.destination);src.start(now);src.stop(now+.95);
 // Short metallic warning ring
 const bell=ctx.createOscillator(),bg=ctx.createGain();bell.type='triangle';bell.frequency.setValueAtTime(720,now+.03);bell.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(260,now+.6);bg.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,now);bg.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(.07,now+.03);bg.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,now+.7);bell.connect(bg);bg.connect(ctx.destination);bell.start(now+.02);bell.stop(now+.72);
 }catch{}}
function startAmbience(){
 if(!audioOn||ambienceTimer)return;
 try{
  ctx=ctx||new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();
  if(ctx.state==='suspended')ctx.resume();
  const master=ctx.createGain();master.gain.value=1.0;master.connect(ctx.destination);
  const add=n=>(ambienceNodes.push(n),n);
  // Deep, slowly shifting abandoned-laboratory atmosphere.
  const droneBus=add(ctx.createGain());droneBus.gain.value=.38;droneBus.connect(master);
  [36.7,55,73.4,110.2].forEach((hz,i)=>{
   const o=add(ctx.createOscillator()),g=add(ctx.createGain()),f=add(ctx.createBiquadFilter());
   o.type=i===0?'sine':'triangle';o.frequency.value=hz;f.type='lowpass';f.frequency.value= i===0?95:260;g.gain.value=[.42,.19,.075,.025][i];
   o.connect(f);f.connect(g);g.connect(droneBus);o.start();
  });
  // Hollow electrical air and distant ventilation, filtered to feel spacious.
  const len=ctx.sampleRate*4,buf=ctx.createBuffer(1,len,ctx.sampleRate),data=buf.getChannelData(0);
  for(let i=0;i<len;i++)data[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*.28;
  const air=add(ctx.createBufferSource()),airF=add(ctx.createBiquadFilter()),airG=add(ctx.createGain());
  air.buffer=buf;air.loop=true;airF.type='lowpass';airF.frequency.value=210;airG.gain.value=.19;air.connect(airF);airF.connect(airG);airG.connect(master);air.start();
  // Slow dissonant string-like tones rise and fade; deliberately no clock/ticking sound.
  const notes=[55,65.41,49,73.42,58.27,43.65,65.41,51.91,77.78,58.27,46.25,69.3];
  let step=0;
  function swell(freq,level=.10,duration=6){
   const t=ctx.currentTime,o=ctx.createOscillator(),sub=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain(),f=ctx.createBiquadFilter();
   o.type='sawtooth';o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq*.997,t);o.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(freq,t+duration*.45);
   sub.type='sine';sub.frequency.value=freq/2;f.type='lowpass';f.frequency.setValueAtTime(180,t);f.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(620,t+duration*.45);f.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(130,t+duration);
   g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(level,t+duration*.42);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+duration);
   o.connect(f);sub.connect(f);f.connect(g);g.connect(master);o.start(t);sub.start(t);o.stop(t+duration+.05);sub.stop(t+duration+.05);
  }
  function metallicEcho(){
   const t=ctx.currentTime,o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain(),f=ctx.createBiquadFilter(),delay=ctx.createDelay(1.5),fb=ctx.createGain();
   o.type='triangle';o.frequency.setValueAtTime(390+Math.random()*220,t);o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(72,t+2.4);
   f.type='bandpass';f.frequency.value=680;f.Q.value=2.5;g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(.10,t+.025);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+2.8);
   delay.delayTime.value=.43;fb.gain.value=.24;o.connect(f);f.connect(g);g.connect(master);g.connect(delay);delay.connect(fb);fb.connect(delay);delay.connect(master);o.start(t);o.stop(t+2.9);
  }
  function reverseWhoosh(){
   const t=ctx.currentTime,n=Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate*3.5),b=ctx.createBuffer(1,n,ctx.sampleRate),a=b.getChannelData(0);
   for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const x=i/n;a[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*Math.pow(x,2.6)}
   const src=ctx.createBufferSource(),f=ctx.createBiquadFilter(),g=ctx.createGain();src.buffer=b;f.type='lowpass';f.frequency.setValueAtTime(120,t);f.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(1250,t+3.3);g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(.23,t+3.2);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+3.5);src.connect(f);f.connect(g);g.connect(master);src.start(t);
  }
  // A slow, irregular sequence instead of a metronomic clock.
  const schedule=()=>{
   if(!audioOn||!ctx)return;
   step++;
   // Evolve the score in four distinct chapters across the full 60-minute session.
   const elapsed=state.started?Math.max(0,(Date.now()-state.started)/1000):0;
   const chapter=Math.min(3,Math.floor(elapsed/900));
   const chapterNotes=[
    [41.2,49,55,65.4,58.3,46.2,73.4,51.9,43.7,61.7],
    [36.7,55,69.3,51.9,77.8,46.2,65.4,38.9,58.3,82.4],
    [32.7,48.9,65.4,43.7,58.3,73.4,41.2,55,69.3,34.6],
    [29.1,43.7,58.3,77.8,38.9,65.4,51.9,82.4,36.7,55]
   ];
   const note=chapterNotes[chapter][(step-1)%chapterNotes[chapter].length];
   const intensity=[.13,.17,.21,.25][chapter];
   swell(note,intensity+(step%3===0?.035:0),[8,7.5,6.5,5.5][chapter]);
   if(step%[3,2,2,1][chapter]===0)reverseWhoosh();
   if(step%[4,3,2,2][chapter]===0)metallicEcho();
   // More frequent, deeper cinematic impacts as the deadline approaches.
   if(step%[7,6,4,3][chapter]===0)bombThud();
   const next=[8500,7600,6500,5400][chapter]+(step%2?700:0);
   ambienceTimer=setTimeout(schedule,next);
  };
  swell(41.2,.12,10);reverseWhoosh();
  ambienceTimer=setTimeout(schedule,6200);
  ambienceNodes.push(master);
 }catch(e){console.warn('Audio ambience unavailable',e)}
}
function ominousWarning(seconds){
 if(!audioOn||typeof speechSynthesis==='undefined'||voiceWarnings.has(seconds))return;
 voiceWarnings.add(seconds);
 const lines={1800:'Thirty minutes remain... Doctor. I can hear the outbreak growing.',1200:'Twenty minutes... You are running out of time.',600:'Ten minutes remain... Do not let the infection escape.',300:'Five minutes... This laboratory will become your tomb.',180:'Three minutes... You cannot hide from the diagnosis.',120:'Two minutes... I am waiting for your answer.',60:'One minute... Choose carefully, Doctor.',30:'Thirty seconds... Your time is almost gone.',10:'Ten seconds... Decide... NOW.'};
 const phrase=lines[seconds];if(!phrase)return;
 try{
  speechSynthesis.cancel();
  const u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(phrase);
  // Keep the warning at a natural speaking speed; eerie tone comes from a low pitch,
  // ominous wording, and a separate sinister laugh rather than slow speech.
  u.lang='en-US';u.rate=1.0;u.pitch=.28;u.volume=1;
  const voices=speechSynthesis.getVoices();
  const english=voices.filter(v=>/^en/i.test(v.lang));
  const preferred=english.find(v=>/(daniel|david|mark|guy|male|alex)/i.test(v.name))
    ||english.find(v=>/(natural|enhanced|premium)/i.test(v.name)&&/(male|daniel|david|alex)/i.test(v.name))
    ||english.find(v=>/en-GB/i.test(v.lang))||english[0];
  if(preferred)u.voice=preferred;
  const laughAt=[300,180,60,30,10];
  u.onend=()=>{
   if(!audioOn||!laughAt.includes(seconds))return;
   const laugh=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(seconds<=30?'Heh... hahahaha!':'Heh... heh...');
   laugh.lang='en-US';laugh.rate=1.08;laugh.pitch=.18;laugh.volume=1;
   if(preferred)laugh.voice=preferred;
   speechSynthesis.speak(laugh);
  };
  speechSynthesis.speak(u);
 }catch(e){console.warn('Voice warning unavailable',e)}
}
function stopAmbience(){if(typeof speechSynthesis!=="undefined")speechSynthesis.cancel();if(ambienceTimer){clearTimeout(ambienceTimer);clearInterval(ambienceTimer);ambienceTimer=null}ambienceNodes.forEach(n=>{try{n.stop?.();n.disconnect?.()}catch{}});ambienceNodes=[];}
function chirp(ok){sound(ok?660:150,.18,ok?"sine":"sawtooth");setTimeout(()=>sound(ok?880:110,.18),130)}
function updateTimer(){let t=$("timer");t.textContent=fmt(state.remaining);t.className="timer"+(state.remaining<=60?" danger":state.remaining<=600?" warn":"")}
function log(msg){let d=document.createElement("div");d.textContent=new Date().toLocaleTimeString()+"  "+msg;$("log").prepend(d)}
function record(status){let elapsed=Math.round((Date.now()-state.started)/1000),hist=getStore("chronoHistory");hist.unshift({name:state.name,date:new Date().toLocaleString(),elapsed,remaining:state.remaining,errors:state.errors,rooms:state.completed,status});putStore("chronoHistory",hist.slice(0,100));if(status==="COMPLETED"){let board=getStore("chronoBoard");board.push({name:state.name,elapsed,date:new Date().toLocaleDateString()});board.sort((a,b)=>a.elapsed-b.elapsed);putStore("chronoBoard",board.slice(0,50));}}
function fail(reason){if(state.ended)return;state.ended=true;clearInterval(tick);stopAmbience();record("FAILED");clearSavedGame();$("failReason").textContent=reason;show("failed");sound(100,.7,"sawtooth")}
function penalty(message){bombThud();state.errors++;state.remaining=Math.max(0,state.remaining-60);$("errors").textContent=state.errors;updateTimer();chirp(false);$("feedback").innerHTML='<div class="notice bad">'+message+' // ONE-MINUTE PENALTY</div>';if(state.remaining<=0)fail("The investigation clock has expired.");}
function wrongAnswer(message){chirp(false);const box=$("feedback");if(box)box.innerHTML='<div class="notice bad">'+message+' // NO TIME PENALTY. TRY AGAIN.</div>';}
function startMissionClock(){
 clearInterval(tick);
 tick=setInterval(()=>{
  if(!state.started||state.ended)return;
  state.remaining=Math.max(0,state.remaining-1);
  updateTimer();
  if([1800,1200,600,300,180,120,60,30,10].includes(state.remaining))ominousWarning(state.remaining);
  if(state.remaining===10)bombThud();
  if(state.remaining<=0){fail("The investigation clock has expired.");return;}
  saveGame();
 },1000);
}
function begin(){
 clearInterval(tick);stopAmbience();clearSavedGame();
 let name=$("singleName")?.value?.trim()||"MEDICAL TEAM";
 state={name,remaining:3600,room:0,errors:0,completed:0,gatePassed:[],started:Date.now(),ended:false,screenMode:"room",symbolEntered:[],finalEntered:[]};
 voiceWarnings=new Set();
 $("operator").textContent=name;$("errors").textContent="0";$("completed").textContent="0 / 4";$("log").textContent="";
 show("game");renderRoom();updateTimer();startAmbience();
 log("Laboratory access initiated for "+name+".");saveGame();startMissionClock();
}
function resumeGame(){
 let saved;try{saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY)||"null")}catch{}
 if(!saved?.state)return;
 clearInterval(tick);stopAmbience();
 state={...saved.state,started:Date.now()-(3600-saved.state.remaining)*1000,ended:false};
 voiceWarnings=new Set();
 $("operator").textContent=state.name;$("errors").textContent=state.errors;$("completed").textContent=state.completed+" / 4";$("log").innerHTML=saved.log||"";
 if(saved.mode==="gate"){show("game");renderSymbolKeyboard(state.room);restoreInputs(saved.inputs);}
 else if(saved.mode==="final"){show("final");renderFinalSymbolKeyboard();restoreInputs(saved.inputs);}
 else{show("game");renderRoom();restoreInputs(saved.inputs);if(state.room===1&&state.labReportVisible)showLabReport();}
 updateTimer();state.screenMode=saved.mode||"room";startAmbience();startMissionClock();saveGame();
}

function roomDone(){
 state.completed++;$("completed").textContent=state.completed+" / 4";
 document.querySelectorAll(".pip").forEach((p,i)=>p.classList.toggle("done",i<state.completed));
 log("Case file "+(state.room+1)+" verified. Symbol-keyboard access check required.");chirp(true);
 state.screenMode="gate";state.symbolEntered=[];saveGame();setTimeout(()=>renderSymbolKeyboard(state.room),350);
}
function renderRoom(){let n=state.room;
const names=["THE INFECTION ROOM","THE TESTING LAB","THE FATALITY CHAMBER","THE FINAL UNLOCK"];
const desc=["Enter the answers from your physical question sheet.","Enter the answers from your physical question sheet.","Enter the answers from your physical question sheet.","Enter the answers from your physical question sheet."];
$("roomTag").textContent="CASE FILE 0"+(n+1)+" / 04";$("roomTitle").textContent=names[n];$("roomNeed").textContent=["CROSSWORD","SUDOKU + LAB REPORT","NEWS REPORT + TRUE/FALSE","RECOVERED FILE ANSWERS"][n];$("roomText").textContent=desc[n];$("roomCount").textContent=(n+1)+" / 4";$("feedback").innerHTML="";document.querySelectorAll(".pip").forEach((p,i)=>p.classList.toggle("done",i<state.completed));
if(n===0)renderRoom1();if(n===1)renderRoom2();if(n===2)renderRoom3();if(n===3)renderRoom4();
}

const cipherGlyphs=["data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,"];

// The physical A–Z reference sheet is supplied by the players. In-game, show only
// the 26 symbol keys (no alphabet labels). Players find the required symbols in
// the physical room picture and enter them here after finishing that room.
function shuffledSymbolIndexes(){const ids=cipherGlyphs.map((_,i)=>i);for(let i=ids.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[ids[i],ids[j]]=[ids[j],ids[i]];}return ids;}
function renderSymbolKeyboard(roomNo){
 state.screenMode="gate";
 const expected={0:[4,11],1:[0,18],2:[18,4],3:[12]};
 const roomNames=["ROOM 1 FILE COMPLETE","ROOM 2 FILE COMPLETE","ROOM 3 FILE COMPLETE","ROOM 4 FILE COMPLETE"];
 const answer=expected[roomNo];let entered=Array.isArray(state.symbolEntered)?[...state.symbolEntered]:[];
 $("roomTag").textContent=`ARCHIVE ACCESS // AFTER CASE FILE 0${roomNo+1}`;
 $("roomTitle").textContent=roomNames[roomNo];
 $("roomNeed").textContent="SYMBOL KEYBOARD";
 $("roomText").textContent="";
 const keys=shuffledSymbolIndexes().map(i=>`<button type="button" class="symbol-key" data-symbol="${i}" aria-label="Symbol key"><img src="${cipherGlyphs[i]}" alt="symbol"></button>`).join("");
 $("puzzleArea").innerHTML=`<section class="cipher-gate post-room-code">
  <div class="eyebrow">CASE FILE VERIFIED // NEXT ACCESS CHECK</div>
  <h3>ACCESS VERIFICATION</h3>
  <div class="cipher-message-label">ENTRY</div>
  <div id="symbolEntry" class="cipher-message symbol-entry" aria-live="polite"></div>
  <div class="symbol-keyboard">${keys}</div>
  <div class="actions"><button type="button" id="symbolBack">BACKSPACE</button><button type="button" id="symbolClear">CLEAR</button><button type="button" class="primary" id="submitSymbolCode">CONFIRM CODE</button></div>
  <div id="symbolFeedback"></div>
 </section>`;
 const entry=$("symbolEntry");
 const draw=()=>{entry.innerHTML=entered.length?entered.map(i=>`<span class="symbol-entry-item"><img src="${cipherGlyphs[i]}" alt="selected symbol"></span>`).join(""):'<span class="muted">Select symbols from the keyboard</span>';};
 document.querySelectorAll(".symbol-key").forEach(btn=>btn.onclick=()=>{if(entered.length<answer.length){entered.push(Number(btn.dataset.symbol));state.symbolEntered=[...entered];draw();saveGame();sound(360,.08,"triangle");}});
 $("symbolBack").onclick=()=>{entered.pop();state.symbolEntered=[...entered];draw();saveGame();};
 $("symbolClear").onclick=()=>{entered=[];state.symbolEntered=[];draw();saveGame();};
 $("submitSymbolCode").onclick=()=>{
  if(entered.length===answer.length&&[...entered].sort((a,b)=>a-b).every((v,i)=>v===[...answer].sort((a,b)=>a-b)[i])){
   $("symbolFeedback").innerHTML='<div class="notice good">SYMBOL CODE ACCEPTED // NEXT FILE RELEASED</div>';
   chirp(true);log("Symbol code accepted after Room "+(roomNo+1)+".");
   setTimeout(()=>{if(roomNo===3){state.screenMode="final";show("final");renderFinalSymbolKeyboard();saveGame();}else{state.room=roomNo+1;state.screenMode="room";state.symbolEntered=[];renderRoom();saveGame();}},550);
  }else{
   $("symbolFeedback").innerHTML='<div class="notice bad">INCORRECT SYMBOL SEQUENCE // CHECK THE PHYSICAL EVIDENCE.</div>';
   penalty("SYMBOL CODE REJECTED");entered=[];draw();
  }
 };
 draw();
}

const room1Answers=[
 [1,"FEVER","An early symptom; a high body temperature."],
 [2,"CONJUNCTIVITIS","Inflammation of the eyes, causing redness."],
 [3,"WHITE","The colour of the characteristic small spots."],
 [4,"MOUTH","Where the small characteristic spots are found."],
 [5,"RASH","A red skin eruption that appears on the face."],
 [6,"DOWNWARDS","The direction the rash spreads across the body."],
 [7,"EXPOSURE","Contact with the infectious source."],
 [8,"SEVEN","The lower number in the stated 7–14 day interval."],
 [9,"INCUBATION","The period between exposure and symptom appearance."],
 [10,"AIRBORNE","The route through which measles spreads."]
];

{word:"AIRBORNE",row:0,col:0,dir:"down",num:1},{word:"DOWNWARDS",row:3,col:9,dir:"across",num:2},
{word:"WHITE",row:3,col:13,dir:"down",num:3},{word:"INCUBATION",row:4,col:5,dir:"down",num:4},
{word:"CONJUNCTIVITIS",row:5,col:3,dir:"across",num:5},{word:"EXPOSURE",row:7,col:0,dir:"across",num:6},
{word:"FEVER",row:7,col:12,dir:"across",num:7},{word:"RASH",row:7,col:16,dir:"down",num:8},
{word:"MOUTH",row:10,col:2,dir:"across",num:9},{word:"SEVEN",row:13,col:1,dir:"across",num:10}]};
function renderRoom1(){
 const a=$("puzzleArea");
 a.innerHTML=`<section class="crossword-panel"><div class="eyebrow">LAB STATION 01 // THE INFECTION ROOM</div><h3>ANSWER ENTRY</h3><div id="r1AnswerFields" class="answer-grid"></div><div class="actions"><button class="primary" id="checkR1">SUBMIT ANSWERS</button></div><div id="r1feedback"></div></section>`;
 const host=$("r1AnswerFields");room1Answers.forEach((q,i)=>{const d=document.createElement("div");d.className="answer-slot";d.innerHTML=`<label>ANSWER ${i+1}</label><input class="field r1-answer" data-i="${i}" placeholder="Enter answer ${i+1}" autocomplete="off">`;host.append(d)});
 $("checkR1").onclick=()=>{const vals=[...host.querySelectorAll("input")].map(x=>norm(x.value));if(vals.every((v,i)=>v===room1Answers[i][1])){$("r1feedback").innerHTML='<div class="notice good">ANSWERS VERIFIED</div>';roomDone()}else{$("r1feedback").innerHTML='<div class="notice bad">SOME ANSWERS ARE INCORRECT OR MISSING.</div>';wrongAnswer("ROOM 1 ANSWERS INCORRECT")}};
}

const sudoku=[
[2,3,9,0,7,0,5,4,6],[0,5,6,2,9,3,8,1,0],[1,8,7,5,6,4,2,9,3],
[3,7,4,9,0,5,6,8,0],[5,0,8,3,4,2,1,7,9],[9,2,1,6,8,7,4,0,5],
[7,4,0,8,2,9,0,6,1],[6,9,2,0,3,1,7,0,8],[8,1,3,7,5,6,9,2,4]];
const sudokuSolution=[
[2,3,9,1,7,8,5,4,6],[4,5,6,2,9,3,8,1,7],[1,8,7,5,6,4,2,9,3],
[3,7,4,9,1,5,6,8,2],[5,6,8,3,4,2,1,7,9],[9,2,1,6,8,7,4,3,5],
[7,4,5,8,2,9,3,6,1],[6,9,2,4,3,1,7,5,8],[8,1,3,7,5,6,9,2,4]];
const room2Answers=["4.21","6.53","B","8.71","A","5.43","C"];
function renderRoom2(){
 const a=$("puzzleArea");
 a.innerHTML=`<section class="crossword-panel"><div class="eyebrow">LAB STATION 02 // THE TESTING LAB</div><h3>THE TESTING LAB — SUDOKU</h3><div id="sudokuGrid" style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(9,minmax(25px,1fr));max-width:440px;margin:14px auto;border:2px solid #4a3926"></div><div class="actions"><button class="primary" id="checkSudoku">CHECK SUDOKU</button><button id="clearSudoku">CLEAR EMPTY CELLS</button></div><div id="sudokuFeedback"></div><div id="labReport" class="hidden"></div></section>`;
 const g=$("sudokuGrid");
 const marked={"0,3":"#e8b8b0","0,5":"#e8b8b0","1,0":"#b8d5dc","1,8":"#e8b8b0","3,4":"#e8b8b0","3,8":"#b8d5dc","4,1":"#b8d5dc","5,7":"#b8d5dc","6,2":"#b8d5dc","6,6":"#e8b8b0","7,3":"#b8d5dc","7,7":"#e8b8b0"};
 sudoku.forEach((row,r)=>row.forEach((v,c)=>{
  const box=document.createElement("div");
  box.style.cssText=`aspect-ratio:1;border:1px solid #9c896b;${c%3===2&&c!==8?'border-right:2px solid #4a3926;':''}${r%3===2&&r!==8?'border-bottom:2px solid #4a3926;':''}background:${marked[r+","+c]||(v===0?"#fff8e9":"#e5d6bb")};display:grid;place-items:center;`;
  if(v){box.textContent=v;box.style.fontWeight="800"}
  else{
   const inp=document.createElement("input");inp.className="sudoku-input";inp.inputMode="numeric";inp.maxLength=1;inp.dataset.r=r;inp.dataset.c=c;
   inp.style.cssText="width:100%;height:100%;border:0;background:transparent;text-align:center;font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:#20180f";
   inp.addEventListener("input",()=>{inp.value=inp.value.replace(/[^1-9]/g,"");saveGame()});box.append(inp);
  }
  g.append(box);
 }));
 $("checkSudoku").onclick=()=>{
  let good=true;g.querySelectorAll("input").forEach(inp=>{if(Number(inp.value)!==sudokuSolution[Number(inp.dataset.r)][Number(inp.dataset.c)])good=false});
  if(!good){$("sudokuFeedback").innerHTML='<div class="notice bad">DATABASE STILL CORRUPTED // Check the missing values.</div>';wrongAnswer("SUDOKU INCORRECT");return}
  $("sudokuFeedback").innerHTML='<div class="notice good">DATABASE RESTORED // MOCK LAB REPORT AVAILABLE</div>';showLabReport();saveGame();
 };
 $("clearSudoku").onclick=()=>{g.querySelectorAll("input").forEach(x=>x.value="");$("sudokuFeedback").innerHTML="";saveGame()};
}
function showLabReport(){
 let report=$("labReport");report.classList.remove("hidden");
 report.innerHTML=`<h3>MOCK MEASLES IgM / IgG REPORT</h3><p>Use the decoded numerical results and the interpretation guide supplied with the case file. Enter the recovered results and their interpretation codes.</p><table class="list"><tr><th>Patient</th><th>Test result</th><th>Interpretation code</th></tr><tr><td>P-001</td><td>IgM <input class="field" id="p1igm" placeholder="0.00"> &nbsp; IgG <input class="field" id="p1igg" placeholder="0.00"></td><td><select class="field" id="p1code"><option value="">Select</option><option>A</option><option>B</option><option>C</option></select></td></tr><tr><td>P-003</td><td>IgG <input class="field" id="p2igg" placeholder="0.00"></td><td><select class="field" id="p2code"><option value="">Select</option><option>A</option><option>B</option><option>C</option></select></td></tr><tr><td>P-007</td><td>IgM <input class="field" id="p3igm" placeholder="0.00"></td><td><select class="field" id="p3code"><option value="">Select</option><option>A</option><option>B</option><option>C</option></select></td></tr></table><div class="actions"><button class="primary" id="checkLab">SUBMIT LAB REPORT</button></div><div id="labFeedback"></div>`;
 $("checkLab").onclick=()=>{let vals=[$("p1igm").value.trim(),$("p1igg").value.trim(),$("p1code").value,$("p2igg").value.trim(),$("p2code").value,$("p3igm").value.trim(),$("p3code").value],ans=["4.21","6.53","B","8.71","A","5.43","C"];if(vals.every((v,i)=>v===ans[i])){$("labFeedback").innerHTML='<div class="notice good">LABORATORY FINDINGS VERIFIED // THREE PATIENT REPORTS RESTORED</div>';roomDone()}else{$("labFeedback").innerHTML='<div class="notice bad">REPORT MISMATCH // Check the values and interpretation codes.</div>';wrongAnswer("LAB REPORT INCORRECT")}};
}
const newsQuestions=[
["What complication affects the lungs?","PNEUMONIA"],
["What is the medical term for brain inflammation?","ENCEPHALITIS"],
["What does SSPE stand for?","SUBACUTE SCLEROSING PANENCEPHALITIS"],
["Which body system does SSPE affect?","CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM"],
["What can severe dehydration cause?","REDUCED CIRCULATING BLOOD VOLUME AND ABNORMAL ELECTROLYTE LEVELS"]
];
function norm(s){return s.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g,"").replace(/^THE/,"")}
function renderRoom3(){
 const a=$("puzzleArea");a.innerHTML=`<section class="crossword-panel"><div class="eyebrow">LAB STATION 03 // THE FATALITY CHAMBER</div><h3>ANSWER ENTRY</h3><div id="r3AnswerFields" class="answer-grid"></div><h3 style="margin-top:18px">TRUE OR FALSE?</h3><div id="tfFields"></div><div class="actions"><button class="primary" id="checkNews">SUBMIT ANSWERS</button></div><div id="newsFeedback"></div></section>`;
 const host=$("r3AnswerFields");
 const expected=[...newsQuestions.map(q=>q[1])];
 expected.forEach((v,i)=>{const d=document.createElement("div");d.className="answer-slot";d.innerHTML=`<label>ANSWER ${i+1}</label><input class="field r3-answer" data-i="${i}" placeholder="Enter answer ${i+1}" autocomplete="off">`;host.append(d)});
 const tf=["Pneumonia affects the lungs.","Encephalitis means inflammation of the brain.","SSPE develops immediately after infection.","SSPE affects the central nervous system.","Severe dehydration can cause low blood volume."];
 const tfKey=["TRUE","TRUE","FALSE","TRUE","TRUE"];
 const tfbox=$("tfFields");tf.forEach((statement,i)=>{const d=document.createElement("div");d.className="answer-slot";d.style.margin="8px 0";d.innerHTML=`<label>${i+1}. ${statement}</label><select class="field tf-answer" data-i="${i}"><option value="">Choose TRUE or FALSE</option><option value="TRUE">TRUE</option><option value="FALSE">FALSE</option></select>`;tfbox.append(d)});
 $("checkNews").onclick=()=>{const vals=[...host.querySelectorAll("input")].map(x=>norm(x.value));const answersValid=vals.every((v,i)=>v===norm(expected[i])||(i===3&&(v==="CNS"||v==="CENTRALNERVOUSSYSTEMCNS"||v==="CENTRALNERVOUSSYSTEM"))||(i===4&&((v.includes("LOWBLOODVOLUME")&&v.includes("ELECTROLYTE"))||v.includes("REDUCEDCIRCULATINGBLOODVOLUME"))));const tfVals=[...tfbox.querySelectorAll("select")].map(x=>x.value);if(answersValid&&tfVals.every((v,i)=>v===tfKey[i])){$("newsFeedback").innerHTML='<div class="notice good">ANSWERS VERIFIED</div>';roomDone()}else{$("newsFeedback").innerHTML='<div class="notice bad">SOME ANSWERS ARE INCORRECT OR MISSING.</div>';wrongAnswer("ROOM 3 ANSWERS INCORRECT")}};
}

const finalAnswers=["NO","ASPIRIN","VITAMINA","DEHYDRATION","MMR","4DAYS","IMMUNOGLOBULIN"];
function renderRoom4(){
 let a=$("puzzleArea");
 a.innerHTML=`<div class="crossword-panel"><div class="eyebrow">LAB STATION 04 // CENTRAL CONTROL DOCUMENT</div><h3>ANSWER ENTRY</h3><div id="finalQuestions"></div><div class="actions"><button class="primary" id="checkFinal">VERIFY FINAL FILE</button></div><div id="finalRoomFeedback"></div></div>`;
 let qbox=$("finalQuestions");
 finalAnswers.forEach((q,i)=>{let d=document.createElement("div");d.style.margin="10px 0";d.innerHTML=`<label>ANSWER ${i+1}</label><input class="field final-answer room4-answer" data-i="${i}" placeholder="Enter answer ${i+1}" autocomplete="off">`;qbox.append(d)});
 $("checkFinal").onclick=()=>{let ans=[...document.querySelectorAll(".final-answer")].map(x=>norm(x.value));if(ans.every((x,i)=>x===finalAnswers[i])){$("finalRoomFeedback").innerHTML='<div class="notice good">FINAL CASE FILE VERIFIED // PREVENTION AND TREATMENT INFORMATION RECOVERED</div>';roomDone()}else{$("finalRoomFeedback").innerHTML='<div class="notice bad">SOME ANSWERS ARE MISSING OR INCORRECT // Recheck the recovered document.</div>';wrongAnswer("FINAL FILE INCORRECT")}};
}

function renderFinalSymbolKeyboard(){
 state.screenMode="final";const target=[12,4,0,18,11,4,18];let entered=Array.isArray(state.finalEntered)?[...state.finalEntered]:[];
 const keys=shuffledSymbolIndexes().map(i=>`<button type="button" class="symbol-key" data-symbol="${i}" aria-label="Symbol key"><img src="${cipherGlyphs[i]}" alt="symbol"></button>`).join("");
 $("finalSymbolArea").innerHTML=`<h3>FINAL DECRYPTION — IDENTIFY THE PATHOGEN</h3><div id="finalSymbolEntry" class="cipher-message symbol-entry" aria-live="polite"></div><div class="symbol-keyboard">${keys}</div><div class="actions" style="justify-content:center"><button id="finalSymbolBack">BACKSPACE</button><button id="finalSymbolClear">CLEAR</button><button class="primary" id="finalSymbolSubmit">CONFIRM IDENTIFICATION</button></div><div id="finalSymbolFeedback"></div>`;
 const entry=$("finalSymbolEntry"),draw=()=>{entry.innerHTML=entered.length?entered.map(i=>`<span class="symbol-entry-item"><img src="${cipherGlyphs[i]}" alt="selected symbol"></span>`).join(""):'<span class="muted">Select symbols</span>';};
 document.querySelectorAll("#finalSymbolArea .symbol-key").forEach(btn=>btn.onclick=()=>{if(entered.length<7){entered.push(Number(btn.dataset.symbol));state.finalEntered=[...entered];draw();saveGame();sound(360,.08,"triangle")}});
 $("finalSymbolBack").onclick=()=>{entered.pop();state.finalEntered=[...entered];draw();saveGame()};
 $("finalSymbolClear").onclick=()=>{entered=[];state.finalEntered=[];draw();saveGame()};
 $("finalSymbolSubmit").onclick=()=>{if(entered.length===7&&entered.every((v,i)=>v===target[i])){completeVictory()}else{$("finalSymbolFeedback").innerHTML='<div class="notice bad">INCORRECT IDENTIFICATION INCORRECT // Recheck the evidence.</div>';penalty("FINAL SYMBOL CODE INCORRECT");entered=[];state.finalEntered=[];draw();saveGame()}};
}
function completeVictory(){
 state.ended=true;clearInterval(tick);record("COMPLETED");clearSavedGame();stopAmbience();
 $("reveal").textContent="MEASLES";
 $("resultStats").textContent=`Doctor / Medical team: ${state.name} · Time taken: ${fmt(3600-state.remaining)} · Time remaining: ${fmt(state.remaining)} · Errors: ${state.errors} · Case files: 4/4`;
 $("victory").querySelector("h1").textContent="CONGRATULATIONS!";
 $("victory").querySelector(".eyebrow").textContent="CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL COMPLETE";
 $("victory").querySelector("p").innerHTML='You completed all four investigations and identified <strong>MEASLES</strong>. The outbreak mystery is solved!';
 let info=document.getElementById("measlesInfo");
 if(!info){info=document.createElement("div");info.id="measlesInfo";info.className="measles-infographic";info.innerHTML=`<div class="info-card"><strong>WHAT IS MEASLES?</strong>A highly contagious viral infection caused by the measles virus.</div><div class="info-card"><strong>HOW DOES IT SPREAD?</strong>Through the airborne route.</div><div class="info-card"><strong>COMMON FEATURES</strong>Fever, conjunctivitis and a characteristic rash.</div><div class="info-card"><strong>PREVENTION</strong>MMR vaccination is the key preventive measure.</div><div class="info-card"><strong>POSSIBLE COMPLICATIONS</strong>Pneumonia, encephalitis and the rare delayed complication SSPE.</div><div class="info-card"><strong>CASE CONCLUSION</strong>Recognise symptoms, prevent transmission and follow appropriate public-health guidance.</div>`;$("victory").insertBefore(info,$("victory").querySelector(".notice"))}
 show("victory");sound(660,.25);setTimeout(()=>sound(880,.5),250);
}

function stopGame(){
 if(!state.started||state.ended)return;
 if(!confirm("Stop this mission and return to the main page? Your answers and progress will be saved."))return;
 saveGame();
 clearInterval(tick);tick=null;stopAmbience();
 state.ended=true;
 show("menu");
 $("saveNotice").textContent="MISSION SAVED. Select CONTINUE SAVED MISSION to resume where you stopped.";
 updateContinueButton();
}
function restart(){
 if(!state.started||state.ended)return;
 if(!confirm("Restart this mission from the beginning? All current progress and saved answers will be erased."))return;
 clearInterval(tick);tick=null;stopAmbience();state.ended=true;
 clearSavedGame();
 begin();
}
$("stop").addEventListener("click",e=>{e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();stopGame();});
$("restart").addEventListener("click",e=>{e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();restart();});
$("sound").addEventListener("click",()=>{audioOn=!audioOn;if(audioOn)startAmbience();else stopAmbience();$("sound").textContent="SOUND: "+(audioOn?"ON":"OFF")});
document.addEventListener("input",e=>{if(e.target.closest("#puzzleArea")||e.target.closest("#finalSymbolArea"))saveGame();});document.addEventListener("change",e=>{if(e.target.closest("#puzzleArea")||e.target.closest("#finalSymbolArea"))saveGame();});

function table(rows,headers){let t=document.createElement("table");t.className="list";let tr=document.createElement("tr");headers.forEach(h=>{let th=document.createElement("th");th.textContent=h;tr.append(th)});t.append(tr);rows.forEach(row=>{let tr=document.createElement("tr");row.forEach(c=>{let td=document.createElement("td");td.textContent=c;tr.append(td)});t.append(tr)});return t}
function renderBoard(){let b=getStore("chronoBoard");$("boardTable").innerHTML="";$("boardTable").append(table(b.map((x,i)=>[i+1,x.name,fmt(x.elapsed),x.date]),["RANK","MEDICAL TEAM","TIME","DATE"]))}
function renderHistory(){let h=getStore("chronoHistory");$("historyTable").innerHTML="";$("historyTable").append(table(h.map(x=>[x.name,x.date,fmt(x.elapsed),x.remaining+"s",x.errors,x.rooms+"/4",x.status]),["MEDICAL TEAM","DATE","ELAPSED","LEFT","ERRORS","FILES","RESULT"]))}
$("start").onclick=begin;$("continueMission").onclick=resumeGame;updateContinueButton();$("showBoard").onclick=()=>{renderBoard();show("board")};$("showHistory").onclick=()=>{renderHistory();show("history")};$("how").onclick=()=>show("help");document.querySelectorAll(".back").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>show("menu"));$("victoryBoard").onclick=()=>{renderBoard();show("board")};$("again").onclick=()=>{show("menu")};$("retry").onclick=()=>{begin()};$("failMenu").onclick=()=>show("menu");
})();
</script></body></html>
